title: Achievement unlocked
description: A player unlocked an achievement in a game. The subject is the unlock.

game_id.description: The game the achievement belongs to.

achievement_slug.description: Stable per-game identifier for the achievement.

trust.description: The trust level the write was accepted at. player means the player's own token unlocked it; game means a game-authoritative write did.

unlocked_at.description: When the achievement unlocked, in the service's clock.
